questions.question: A new hospital information system must keep patient records confidential, limit system downtime to no more than 4 hours per month, and allow nurses to retrieve a patient’s medication history with a single click. Which of the following statements correctly identifies the type of requirement for each of the three needs?

options.A: Confidentiality – functional, Downtime limit – functional, Single‑click retrieval – non‑functional
options.B: Confidentiality – non‑functional, Downtime limit – non‑functional, Single‑click retrieval – functional
options.C: Confidentiality – functional, Downtime limit – non‑functional, Single‑click retrieval – functional
options.D: Confidentiality – non‑functional, Downtime limit – functional, Single‑click retrieval – non‑functional

questions.explanation:
Confidentiality is a security constraint (non‑functional) [Page 8]; the downtime limit is a quantitative reliability constraint (non‑functional) [Page 10]; the single‑click retrieval is a system service (functional) [Page 5].
